code_evidence.handler_guard: Contract.tsx guards clone execution with !canEdit || cloning.
code_evidence.request: Contract.tsx posts /contracts/clone-data with copyParameters, copyExercises and copyAssessmentTypes set to true.
code_evidence.missing_data: Contract.tsx throws cloneError when response.data.data is absent.
code_evidence.feedback: Contract.tsx renders cloneResult and cloneError inside the clone card and disables the button while cloning.

test_evidence.stable_auth_mock: The remediation uses a single hoisted mockUser reference so the Contract loading effect is not retriggered by mock identity churn.
test_evidence.success_case: The test clicks Clonar dados, asserts exactly one POST with all three copy flags and asserts created/skipped totals in the clone card.
test_evidence.error_case: The test rejects the clone POST with an API error and asserts that error beside the clone action.
test_evidence.suite_result: The exact-head Validate PR run passed the Test step after the remediation.

limitations: No local network checkout was available in the execution runtime; exact repository validation is the completed GitHub Actions run for the material head.
